events.description: Monica Geller says Monica Geller wants to have a baby.
Chandler Bing says Chandler Bing will have an early day tomorrow.
Monica Geller tells Chandler Bing to get up and come along, and says Monica Geller and Chandler Bing should go get some coffee.
Chandler Bing says Monica Geller and Chandler Bing often already do that activity of getting coffee.
Joey Tribbiani urges the basketball player to shoot.
Joey Tribbiani says the basketball player could just fall down, which Joey Tribbiani says would also be good.
Lydia says the New York Knicks are bad.
Joey Tribbiani tells Lydia to listen.
Lydia tells Joey Tribbiani to look at Patrick Ewing.
Lydia says Patrick Ewing could not hit water even if Patrick Ewing were standing on a boat.
Joey Tribbiani asks Lydia which team Lydia likes.
Joey Tribbiani says the Boston Celtics could not hit a boat.
Joey Tribbiani tells Lydia to wait.
Joey Tribbiani says the Boston Celtics are bad.
Lydia tells Joey Tribbiani to shut up.
Lydia tells Joey Tribbiani that the Boston Celtics are in a rebuilding year.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani will get the baby's father for Lydia and calls out that Joey Tribbiani and the nearby people need the father over here.
Lydia says there is no father of Lydia's baby.
Lydia says Joey Tribbiani's apology is okay.
Lydia says Lydia is fine.
Joey Tribbiani says all the other pregnant women are going into this room.
